digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review bot criterion deployment and dogfood validation
propositions: A live Gerrit review bot probe must validate the deployed criterion loads and executes through the full four-pass pipeline without blocking contributors during initial rollout.

The positive-control patchset refines Pass-1 discovery to require explicit identification of instructed phase, assigned action, and owning phase; it must emit no finding because the directive is valid.

The predeclared RP-F2 FIRE-control patchset must produce a project-attributed advisory finding carrying reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria [project.review-phase-boundaries] with Pass-2 validity/impact and Pass-3 decision/priority/threshold data.

The final submitted patchset removes all negative directives and contains only phase-compliant instructions identical to the positive control, leaving blocking_enabled=false and block_threshold=0.90 unchanged.
